title: Deep Closing: Enhancing Topological Connectivity in Medical Tubular Segmentation
mechanism: A masked-image-modelling autoencoder trained on label masks learns a tubular shape prior and flags likely disconnections; a simple-components erosion keeps only topologically meaningful additions to the base segmentation.
adaptation: Train the shape prior on crack label masks only (no images), so all labelled crack masks can be used; apply to house predictions to close gaps between collinear fragments; guard against bridging across busbars.
min_experiment: Arm: house ensemble + Deep Closing. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: components found, relR@2 at fixed relP@2, crack IoU on 5-fold CV and E1. Kill: relR@2 gain < +0.01 or relP@2 drop > 0.01.
evidence: R: topology metrics improved on DRIVE, CHASE_DB1, DCA1, CREMI; transfers knowledge from external datasets (numbers not read).
prior_overlap: Partly near soft clDice and Skeleton Recall losses (BRIEF section 5), but those are training losses; a post-hoc label-only shape prior was not tested.
